text:
Ava Chen: Quick design review for the autoscale onboarding modal. Main asks: SLO slider default, min/max labels, burst wording, and guardrail copy.
Liam Patel: The current SLO default (92%) boosts min unexpectedly for new users. Recommend soft default 70% and explain with short helper.
Sofi Gomez: a11y: pool selector still traps focus after close on VoiceOver. Make it role=dialog and ensure focus returns to trigger. Add aria-live for the cost delta.
Marco Rivera: Users think "burst" is permanent. Two options: 'Burst (temporary)' label OR add inline helper: 'Short-term extra GPUs — auto-removes.' Also tooltip about billing.
Ellie Tran: Fallback messaging needs to state routing and perf impact. Draft toast: "Fallback active: selected pool at capacity. Routing to Redwood Hosted for availability; expect higher tail latency. Data encrypted in transit. (Details)"
Ava Chen: Love that. Also propose showing a tiny cost delta near the slider and a micro-sparkline beneath min/max when min=0 + burst enabled to indicate cold-start risk.
Liam Patel: I'll prototype the $/hr delta and a subtle sparkline. Keep the cost text low-contrast and add a hover for methodology.
Sofi Gomez: For screen readers, slider should expose aria-valuetext like: 'Reliability 70 percent; increasing reliability may increase cost.' The condensed visual hint must have a visually-hidden full text.
Marco Rivera: Microcopy drafts: Option A: "Burst: temporary extra GPUs for spikes. Auto-removes after 10m." Option B (short): "Temp extra GPUs (auto-remove)."
Ellie Tran: Also add a non-blocking inline banner when fallback is active pointing to a modal that explains perf/privacy tradeoffs and a toggle to disable fallback (with a big warning).
Ava Chen: Action items: Marco finalize copy variants; Liam mock cost delta + sparkline; Sofi run a11y keyboard/VO pass and add aria snippets; Ellie draft fallback modal and disable flow. Target: staging QA by EOD Thursday.
Liam Patel: On it  will drop mocks by EOD.
Sofi Gomez: I'll start a11y pass tomorrow morning and add notes in Figma.
Marco Rivera: Posting copy options later today.
Ellie Tran: I'll write the modal content and the disable fallback confirmation/undo copy.
Ava Chen: Thanks team 44f 3fb 680  I'll update the figma and share the link here when ready."
